title: Between Two Rounds
logline: At a small temple-run elders' home, the same two carers move within one hour from helping a resident through a hard, frightened moment to sitting with another whose grandchild has just visited with good news.

object.note: Object 6 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Relief in a working body gives way to bodies that can no longer carry much: carers at an elders' home moving within one hour from a frightened moment to good news.

thread_out.thread: From the day's rounds at the elders' home to night rounds in a hospital, where a volunteer's tea trolley reaches families who have not left in days.
